g.text: Three Stores, One System: Catalog Documents, a Cart Hash, and the Relational Order Core
Cross-store references are by ID only -- no join, no foreign key, no shared transaction
no cart_items table -- disposable by design
hottest row-level lock in a flash sale
no join, no FK, separate store
CROSS-STORE REFERENCES ARE BY ID ONLY
order_items.product_id points at a document in a completely different store -- there is no transaction spanning both.
A receipt that needs the product's name fetches it from the catalog service separately -- a second call, never a join.
The only place all three stores' data has to agree is the single relational transaction at checkout.
